title: Alarm wall: a red honeycomb of elongated hexagons over a blue screen with a 45-degree lattice; the main panel carries two stamps, two lines of compressed Mincho and two of English; side panels a WARNING and a level mark; the lower row two vote seats and a mode box
use: Emergency and escalation screens, outage pages, the alert state of a dashboard.

scanlines.note: CRT scanlines over the whole screen (3-unit period, 14%)

relations: Hexagons 3.06:1 with 55-degree tips; the main one 1274 x 417 at the top centre, side ones behind it, a lower row of two.
Double rules 6 and 2 units, 12 apart; stamps 214 x 191.
Mincho on the panels at 0.85, English at up to 0.9, under the CJK.
decoration: The lattice, rules and scanlines are drawn and exempt.

provenance.corpus: tidemark case (潮位警报 TIDEMARK): our own original organisation terminal site, two app screens and UI kit in the crisis-command grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/crisis-command/style.json provenance (broadcast and film frames measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: the film remake's alarm wall (3834 x 695 strip, left third): hexagon 835 x 273 in the frame (3.06:1), tips 55 degrees, stamp 140 x 125, WARNING cap 40, red #BA0623 over blue #49688B
measured: Case: 第九排涝区 / 转入防潮战备 at 0 findings.
